business_summary: Nohmi Bosai Ltd. engages in the development, marketing, installation, and maintenance of various fire protection systems in Japan. The company operates through Fire Alarm Equipment, Fire Extinguishing Equipment, and Maintenance and Inspection Services segment. It offers fire alarm systems, such as addressable systems, conventional systems, notification appliances, manual stations, IR3 flame detectors, aspirating smoke detector; engineered and package type nitrogen gas fire suppression systems; foam extinguishing systems; sprinkler systems, foam fire extinguishing systems, plant disaster prevention systems, and tunnel disaster prevention systems. The company includes the manufacture, sale, and installation of automatic fire alarm equipment, environmental monitoring systems, fire doors, smoke control equipment; as well as maintenance, inspection, and repair work related to various fire prevention equipment. Nohmi Bosai Ltd. was founded in 1916 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan. Nohmi Bosai Ltd. is a subsidiary of SECOM Co., Ltd.
